dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Closed and semi-closed 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with irregular, high-contrast dark perimeters transitioning to lighter internal cores, most prominent on the upper-left and central-dorsal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of solid, asymmetrical light-pixel clusters located primarily along the lower lateral line, lacking internal gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli on the upper dorsal surface form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral with the longest axis parallel to the body midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-pigmented regions surrounding both orbital cavities, creating a stark contrast against the lighter snout and forehead regions.
